title: Hybridizable Staggered Discontinuous Galerkin Methods for Polyharmonic Equations on Polytopes
summary: Hybridizable staggered discontinuous Galerkin methods are developed for arbitrary-order polyharmonic equations $(-Δ)^m u=f$ on shape-regular polytopal meshes in $\mathbb R^d$, for any $m\ge1$, $d\ge2$, and polynomial degree $k\ge0$. The method uses the mixed variable $σ=\nabla^m u$ and a staggered primal--dual mesh to impose complementary continuity on scalar and tensor unknowns, without restrictions such as $d\ge m$.
